Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Providence hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 11 of the 15 Providence hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Traveluro at 3, Vio.com at 2, goseek.com at 1, KAYAK.com at 1, klook at 1, Super.com at 1, the hotel's own site at 1 and trivago DEALS at 1. Taxes and fees at Providence hotels

At the 11 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 14% ($23 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 12% at Ramada by Wyndham Seekonk Providence Area to 16% at Hotel Providence. At 3 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
